name: Social Marketing
description: Prepare and approve LinkedIn company-page posts, schedule publication and verify provider receipts.

navLinks.label: Social Marketing
navLinks.description: Drafts, calendar, publication results and setup.

settings.label: Brand guidance
settings.description: Audience, voice, approved claims and topics to avoid. Review every generated draft.

settings.label: Time zone
settings.description: IANA time zone for the automatic weekly boundary. Drafts retain their own time zone.

settings.label: Prepare weekly drafts
settings.description: Create three editable source-excerpt drafts each week. Never approves or publishes.

settings.label: Weekly LinkedIn page ID
settings.description: Copy an active page ID from Social Marketing Setup.

settings.label: Weekly source title
settings.description: Title of the reviewed source used for weekly draft suggestions.

settings.label: Weekly source URL
settings.description: Public HTTPS URL supporting the suggested posts.

settings.label: Weekly source paragraphs
settings.description: Three reviewed paragraphs separated by blank lines. Update regularly; the scheduler preserves excerpts verbatim.
